mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns over the horizon is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns over the horizon is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns over the horizon is negative.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals increased economic activity and potential supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns over the horizon is negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns is not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and SPX returns over the horizon is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 2% over the past 3 months and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a contraction in economic activity coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic contraction with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not significantly negative.
